definition: Any node running this client on its default configuration processes the attacker-supplied input on the affected path.
Only one common node role or default-adjacent mode is affected: validating vs non-validating, archive vs pruned, snap vs full sync, or an endpoint that is enabled by default but not always exposed.
A non-default flag, an unusual platform (for example a 32-bit host), an opt-in feature, or an operator-specific deployment shape is required.
Only the operator's own node is affected through local action; no attacker-supplied remote input crosses to other operators.
Not assessed. Used so an unreviewed row widens its bound instead of silently assuming full reach.
